input_box_content.user_input_content: === REFERENCES === Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity. Use the provided Riven weapon reference exactly as shown. Use the provided Burning Settlement reference for the current environment. Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference only for the dark figure. Maintain the same burning mountain settlement: wooden buildings on fire, heavy dark smoke, orange firelight, ash drifting through the air, and narrow roads running deeper between the buildings. Keep Riven's weapon visually consistent with the provided reference throughout the entire video. Do not redesign or alter the weapon. === TECHNICAL === 16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy. Grounded photorealistic realism. Burning settlement at nightfall. Strong orange firelight. Heavy drifting smoke. Natural ash and embers in the air. Natural running movement with realistic speed, body weight, and momentum. Dynamic but controlled cinematic camera movement. Natural footsteps, breathing, fire, burning wood, wind, and environmental sound. No dialogue. No subtitles. No background music. No combat yet. Keep the mysterious figure difficult to see during the pursuit. Use only THREE major cinematic shots. === VIDEO SUMMARY === Riven is looking deeper into the burning settlement after the mysterious figure has disappeared. Suddenly, she hears the same strange sound from somewhere far deeper inside the village. Riven immediately recognizes it. Through the distant smoke, she briefly sees a dark figure move across an opening between burning buildings. Riven reacts instantly. She breaks into a full-speed sprint and pursues it deeper into the settlement. During the chase, Riven occasionally catches brief glimpses of the dark figure moving farther ahead through the smoke. It never remains visible long enough for her to reach it. The pursuit leads Riven deeper into a more isolated part of the burning settlement. Eventually, Riven reaches a wider open area. The dark figure is nowhere to be seen. Riven slows and searches the smoke. Then the mysterious figure finally emerges and stands still ahead of her. Riven stops. They face each other. CUT before combat begins. === SHOT 1 — SHE HEARS IT === OPEN on Riven looking down the burning village road. She is alone. The mysterious figure is no longer visible. Do not recreate a long static establishing shot. Keep the opening brief. Fire burns throughout the settlement. Dark smoke moves between the buildings. Ash drifts through the orange light. Riven quietly scans the road ahead. Then— from somewhere FAR DEEPER inside the settlement, a faint unnatural sound is heard. Riven immediately reacts. Her head turns sharply toward the sound. She recognizes it. Camera follows her gaze far down the burning road. At first there is only: fire, smoke, burning structures, and empty space. Then— far ahead, through a temporary opening in the smoke, a DARK HUMAN-LIKE FIGURE moves quickly across the road between two burning structures. It is only visible for a brief moment. Do not clearly reveal its face or body. Do not make it stop and pose. It crosses the distant opening and immediately disappears behind smoke and structures. Riven sees it. There is almost no hesitation. She immediately launches forward into a FULL-SPEED SPRINT. Her first steps are explosive and urgent. The camera accelerates with her. Riven races directly toward the place where she saw the figure. === SHOT 2 — THE PURSUIT === Stay close to Riven as she runs at full speed deeper into the burning settlement. Use a dynamic tracking camera. Alternate naturally between: close rear tracking, three-quarter side tracking, and brief low tracking near her running legs, without turning the sequence into many separate disconnected shots. Riven runs hard. Her body leans naturally forward. Her arms drive with her stride. Her hair and clothing react naturally to the speed of her movement. Her breathing becomes stronger. Keep her weapon secure and visually consistent with the provided reference. The environment rushes past her. Burning wooden buildings line the road. Smoke moves across her path. She passes scattered debris. Firelight flickers rapidly across her as she moves between structures. Riven is not running randomly. She is FOLLOWING the mysterious figure. Far ahead— another brief DARK MOVEMENT appears through the smoke. The figure crosses another opening. Riven catches sight of it. She immediately adjusts her direction and continues the pursuit. Keep the mysterious figure ALWAYS FARTHER AHEAD OF RIVEN. It never runs beside her. It never runs behind her. Riven never catches it during the chase. Do not show the figure running like a normal human. Its movement should feel strange and unnaturally fast. A dark silhouette briefly glides or rushes through the smoke, then disappears again behind the environment. Riven keeps chasing it. The roads become narrower. The crowd and civilians are completely gone. The deeper Riven goes, the more isolated the environment becomes. She runs through another thick bank of smoke. For a moment, the smoke fills most of the frame. Riven pushes through it. === SHOT 3 — IT STOPS RUNNING === Riven emerges from the smoke into a wider open area deep inside the burning settlement. A small crossroads, open village yard, or wider section between damaged buildings. There is more space here. Burning structures surround the area. Smoke drifts slowly across the ground and between the buildings. Riven continues running forward for several steps. But— the mysterious figure is nowhere to be seen. Riven quickly slows. Her sprint becomes a controlled stop. She looks ahead. Nothing. She looks toward one side. Only smoke and fire. Then toward the other. Still nothing. Keep the tension quiet. Only Riven's breathing, the fire, and the sound of burning wood remain. Riven becomes completely still. She watches the smoke. Then— ahead of her, a large section of dark smoke slowly shifts. The MYSTERIOUS DARK FIGURE gradually becomes visible. This time— IT IS NOT RUNNING. It stands motionless on the opposite side of the open area. Keep a clear distance between them. The figure remains almost humanoid, but subtly unnatural. Its silhouette is dark. Its shoulders appear slightly too high. Its arms appear slightly too long. Its edges blend unnaturally into the surrounding smoke. Orange firelight does not illuminate it normally. Its face remains unclear. No glowing eyes. No clear facial details. Riven immediately locks her attention onto it. The figure does not disappear. It does not move away. It simply stands there. Riven understands: the chase is over. Slowly, Riven shifts her posture. Her breathing begins to settle. Her hand moves toward her weapon. Keep the weapon exactly consistent with the provided reference. The mysterious figure remains still. Hold a wider composition: Riven on one side of the burning open area. The mysterious figure on the opposite side. Fire and smoke between them. Neither attacks yet. Hold the confrontation briefly. CUT. === END STATE === Riven heard the mysterious figure deeper inside the burning settlement. She saw it briefly and immediately pursued it at full speed. The figure led her deeper through the burning village. Riven has now reached a wider isolated area. The mysterious figure has stopped fleeing. It stands directly ahead of her. Riven prepares herself. No combat has begun yet. CUT.
